title: Thai Coconut Curry Soup (Raw Vegan)
excerpt: This cool raw vegan soup is rich in flavor, perfectly creamy, with just the perfect amount of spice!
content:
Ingredients

  • 2 C. Shiitake Mushrooms, Sliced
  • Sprinkle w/Lime Juice, set aside
  • Blend until smooth:
  • 1/8 C. Lime/Lemon Juice
  • 2 Cloves Garlic
  • 2 inch Ginger Root
  • 1 Tsp. Curry Powder
  • 1 C. Fresh Coconut Meat
  • 2 C. Coconut Water
  • 2 C. Water
  • 2 Scallions
  • 1 Avocado
  • Pinch of Cayenne

Method

  1. Add shiitake to soup and serve.
